      How to move around

      Orbit
      Drag, or one finger. Keys Q and E, or the arrows beside the compass.
      Pan
      Right-drag or Shift-drag, or two fingers. Arrow keys or W A S D.
      Zoom
      Scroll or pinch. Keys + and -, or the buttons. Double-click flies to a spot.
      Inspect
      Click or tap the map for elevation, state and coordinates.
      Find
      Press / and type a state, city or peak.
      Tours
      Keys 1 to 9, or Explore.
      Other keys
      L place names, B state lines, H hide the interface, R whole map, Esc close a panel, ? this help.

      About the data

      Elevation: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen, AWS Open Data). Land cover: NLCD 2021 (USGS). Coast, lakes, rivers, state lines: Natural Earth. Elevation is real, sampled at 2.5 km and then sharpened with generated detail, so summits read lower than their true height. Heights on screen are exaggerated, regional height more than local relief. The readout and the info card give true elevation. Trees and buildings are placed from land cover and population, not surveyed. Not for navigation.
